name: Whiskey Sour (Sour Mix)
description: Bourbon and sweet-and-sour mix—the weeknight sour when you do not want to juice lemons.
history: American bars have used bottled sour mix in whiskey sours since the mid-20th century. Fresh lemon plus simple syrup is still the better drink; this is the honest shortcut.
whyItWorks: Sour mix already contains citrus and sugar, so the only job left is choosing a bourbon that can stand up to it.
steps: Shake bourbon and sour mix hard with ice.
Garnish with lemon and a cherry; add a dash of bitters if you like.
techniqueNotes: If the mix is very sweet, cut it to 1 oz and add a squeeze of lemon.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Softer fruit if the mix is sharp.
The shortcut this recipe exists for.

variations.name: Whiskey Sour
variations.notes: Fresh lemon and simple syrup—the preferred version.
